description: Enables businesses to programmatically manage LinkedIn marketing campaigns, target audiences, track conversions, and analyze ad performance.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow is used to authenticate users and issue access tokens for API requests.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free developer account and create apps, but specific marketing and advertising APIs require product/admin approval or partnership tier access.
api_notes: Covers campaign management, advertising, reporting/analytics, lead sync, matched audiences, conversions, and community management.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by LinkedIn or Microsoft; community MCP options may exist independently.
rationale: While developers can create a self-serve developer account, accessing LinkedIn Marketing and Ads APIs requires specific product access approvals or partnership status.

evidence.note: Outlines LinkedIn Marketing API program features including advertising, campaign management, reporting, and lead sync.
Mentions developer portal access and app management at linkedin.com/developers/apps.
